input: Find a notary for the power of attorney document

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The user's city, country, or region determines which notary services, legal requirements, and directories are relevant — notarization rules vary significantly by jurisdiction.
The type of power of attorney (general, durable, medical, financial, limited) affects which notary is qualified and what additional witnesses or certifications may be required.
How urgently the document needs to be notarized shapes whether to pursue same-day mobile notaries, online notarization platforms, or standard appointments.
Whether the user prefers an in-person notary, a mobile notary who comes to them, or a remote online notary determines which options to surface.
Knowing how many signers are involved and whether all parties are available in the same location affects which notary service can accommodate the appointment.
The user's budget for notarization fees determines whether free options (bank notaries, libraries) or paid services (mobile, online) are more appropriate.

Understanding whether the document will be used domestically or internationally (e.g., requiring an apostille) determines whether a standard notarization is sufficient or extra certification steps are needed.

gold.taskTitle: Find a notary for the power of attorney
gold.taskDescription: The user needs to locate and arrange a notary to officially notarize a power of attorney document.

questions.title: What city or country do you need the notary in?
questions.description: The user's location determines applicable legal requirements, available notary directories, and jurisdiction-specific rules for power of attorney documents.

questions.title: What type of power of attorney needs notarizing?
questions.description: General, durable, medical, financial, or limited POA may have different notarization or witness requirements depending on local law.

questions.title: How soon does the document need to be notarized?
questions.description: The urgency determines whether to pursue same-day, next-day, or standard appointment options.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person, mobile, or online notarization?
questions.description: The preferred format narrows the search to the right type of notary service.

questions.title: How many people need to sign the document?
questions.description: The number of signers and whether they are in the same location affects which notary services can handle the appointment.

questions.title: What is your budget for notarization fees?
questions.description: Budget determines whether free options like bank or library notaries are preferable, or if paid mobile and online services are acceptable.

questions.title: Will this document be used domestically or internationally?
questions.description: International use may require an apostille or additional certification beyond standard notarization.
